claim_scope: external Combine feature-engineering benchmark; not a get-off or tracking-transfer advantage

audit.identity_join: PFR ID to unique GSIS ID; no name joins
audit.outcome_scope: conditional on explicit observed NFL outcome; absent players remain unknown
audit.predictor_availability: Combine numeric traits and Combine position; no draft pick/career/updated NFL role

protocol.inner_folds: last three eligible earlier draft classes
protocol.bootstrap: fixed-prediction class-plus-player paired resampling; does not refit models
protocol.quadratic_basis: degree-two expansion across scaled numeric traits, missingness indicators and Combine-position one-hot indicators; includes numeric-by-position interactions
